# Support

## How to Get Help

- **Bug reports** — [Open an issue](https://github.com/gitswagata1/momentum/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **Feature requests** — [Open an issue](https://github.com/gitswagata1/momentum/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- **Questions** — Open a [Discussion](https://github.com/gitswagata1/momentum/discussions) or comment on an existing issue
- **Security issues** — See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

## Before Opening an Issue

1. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/gitswagata1/momentum/issues) to avoid duplicates
2. Include steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behavior, and your environment
3. Use the issue templates — they help us help you faster
